shortDescription: AUSTIN, Texas, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Phunware, Inc. (“Phunware” or the “Company”) NASDAQ:PHUN, a provider of AI-enabled guest intelligence software to operators of hotels, resorts and other large, complex properties, today announced that Phunware’s CEO, Dmitry Kroshka, will host an in-p…

children: , a provider of AI-enabled guest intelligence software to operators of hotels, resorts and other large, complex properties, today announced that Phunware’s CEO, Dmitry Kroshka, will host an in-person presentation and one-on-one meetings at the LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event, taking place October 20–21, 2026 at the Luxe Sunset Boulevard Hotel in Los Angeles, California.

Mr. Kroshka’s presentation will highlight Phunware 2.0, the Company’s repositioning around the Guest Intelligence Platform, which is sold as a recurring subscription per property and expanded module by module. The platform brings together location, property management and transactional data to help guests discover what a property offers, find their way around it and book dining, spa services and activities, and to give operators a clearer view of what their guests want and ancillary income generated. He will also discuss AI Concierge, which was commercially released in January 2026 and is in production, the Company’s roadmap for the AI Itinerary Builder and the Location-Aware Data Layer, and the planned expansion of the platform beyond hospitality into healthcare campuses and senior living.
Location: Luxe Sunset Boulevard Hotel, Los Angeles, CA
Presentation: Tuesday, October 20, 2026, 10:30 a.m. PT (1:30 p.m. ET), Track 3
Attendees: Chief Executive Officer Dmitry Kroshka
To schedule a one-on-one meeting with Phunware management, please contact your conference representative, email your request to PHUN@mzgroup.us, or call Chris Tyson at (949) 491-8235.

is an enterprise software company specializing in mobile app solutions for hospitality, healthcare and other large property related customers, with integrated intelligent capabilities. We provide businesses with the tools to create, implement, and manage custom mobile applications, analytics, and location-based services. Phunware is transforming mobile engagement by delivering scalable, personalized, and data-driven mobile app experiences.

Phunware’s mission is to achieve unparalleled connectivity and monetization through the widespread adoption of Phunware mobile technologies, leveraging brands, consumers, partners, and market participants. Phunware is poised to expand its software products and services audience through new generative AI products and product enhancements which are in development, utilize and monetize its patents and other intellectual property, and focus on serving its enterprise customers and partners.
For more information on Phunware, please visit www.phunware.com.
